The Property

An ecological windmill,
sustainably restored

Perched at the top of the Algarve hills with stunning panoramic sea views and endless sunrises and sunsets, this is unlike any property you have seen. A centuries-old windmill, lovingly restored, with every detail made by hand — spiral granite staircase, pebble mosaic floors, stone walls that breathe.

15 minutes from Tavira and its world-famous beaches. Close enough to everything. Far enough from all the noise.

"Unique opportunity for eco & tiny house enthusiasts!"

The Dome

A magical geodesic dome roof

The upper floor is crowned with a hand-built geodesic dome ceiling — triangular panels of sky-blue light framed by warm timber beams. By day, sunlight streams through like a living kaleidoscope. By night, it becomes a stargazing observatory like no other.

Built for meditation, yoga, and pure stillness. There is nothing quite like this anywhere in the Algarve.

🌟
Stargazing dome
Lie back and watch the Algarve sky every night

Inside the Mill

Two circular rooms.
One spiral staircase.

The interior is entirely round — two circular rooms connected by a spiral granite staircase carved from stone. The ground floor features handcrafted pebble mosaic floors in concentric spirals, thick stone walls, and an arched doorway that frames the mountains beyond.

The upper floor opens to the geodesic dome, with panoramic windows showing the Algarve valleys. A hanging rattan chair waits for you to sit and watch the world.

Not laid out like a traditional house. Completely unique. Completely yours.

The Land

3,000 m² of organic farmland

The property comes with 3,000 m² of organic agricultural land with bore hole water on site — the foundation for true self-sufficient living. Space for caravans, yurts, additional tiny structures, gardens, and whatever vision you bring.

This is what tiny house enthusiasts dream of: a place where the land works with you, not against you.
